help.name: Identifies the agent in manifests and logs; it no longer changes once published.
help.displayName: The human-readable name shown in lists and runs.
help.description: One sentence saying what the agent is for, shown to whoever picks it.
help.type: Decides how the agent is started: a container image, or an external provider driven by the platform.
help.image: The image started for every run, tag included.
help.useExternal: Has a third-party service (Copilot, Claude Code, OpenAI) run the agent instead of a local image.
help.externalProvider: The third-party service that will run the agent.
help.externalModel: The model asked of that service.
help.externalConfig: Settings passed to the provider verbatim, as name/value pairs.
help.inputs: The fields asked of whoever starts a run; they are what the launch form is built from.
help.outputs: Describes what the agent returns when it finishes, so later steps know what to read.
help.fieldDescription: Shown under the field when starting a run.
help.fieldEnum: Restricts the field to this comma-separated list; leave empty for a free field.
help.vcs: Sets how far the agent may go in the repository: read, push a branch, open a pull request.
help.network: Cuts the network off, opens it fully, or limits it to the hosts listed below.
help.networkAllowlist: The only hosts reachable when network access is restricted; comma-separated.
help.secrets: The secrets injected into the run; the agent sees no other.
help.docker: Hands the agent the host's Docker daemon — grant it only to an agent you trust.
help.writableRootfs: Lets the agent write outside its workspace.
help.profile: The default machine size; the values below refine it.
help.maxDuration: Past this, the run is stopped outright.
help.defaultMaxUsd: What a run started without an explicit budget will cost at most.
help.hardMaxUsd: A cap nobody can exceed, even by asking.
help.approvals: Pauses the run before its first write until a human signs off.
help.approvalRole: The minimum role for someone whose approval counts.
help.approvalCount: How many distinct approvals are needed before resuming.
help.preview: Exactly what will be stored if you submit this form.
